decisions.reason: The margin analysis builds directly on the firm's maintained market-data and tariff know-how, has kept its own page through 2024, and in-house R&D lets the firm interpret results and refine it, so it fits the platform strategy.

The electricity tariff calculator sits close to the core tariff-calculation competence, so the firm can assimilate feedback, but its drop from its own page to a mere mention, while sibling tariff tools were removed, suggests consolidation risk.

The area definition tool builds on the firm's regional market-data databases and likely serves as a supporting component of the central platform, so related knowledge and own R&D favour keeping it despite its reduced web presence.
